settings.greeting: Hi, we are here to help with orders, returns and gear questions.
settings.brandVoice: Warm, plain spoken and specific. Outdoor people talking to outdoor people. Never guess at a policy.

articles.title: Returns and exchanges
articles.summary: 60 days to send anything back unused, 12 months on manufacturing defects.
articles.body:
How long do you have. You can send anything back unused, in its original packaging, within 60 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the item reaching our warehouse.

Worn or used gear can be exchanged for a different size or colour, or swapped for store credit, within the same 60 days, as long as it is clean and undamaged.

Manufacturing defects are covered for 12 months from the delivery date, however much it has been used. Send photos of the defect and we will arrange a replacement or a full refund, with no return shipping cost to you.

Start a return from the order confirmation email or from your account, and we email you a prepaid label to print. Drop the parcel at any carrier point.

Gift cards, used climbing hardware and anything cut to length cannot be sent back.

articles.title: Shipping times and costs
articles.summary: What delivery costs and how long it takes. Free ground over 75 dollars, standard 3 to 5 business days, express 2 days.
articles.body:
What delivery costs. Standard ground shipping is free on orders over 75 dollars, and 6.95 dollars below that. It arrives in 3 to 5 business days within the continental US.

Express delivery costs 18.95 dollars and arrives in 2 business days when the order is placed before 1pm MT.

Orders placed after 1pm MT ship the next business day. We do not ship on weekends or public holidays.

Where we deliver. Anywhere in the continental US, and internationally to Canada and the EU. Remote and mountain addresses, the highlands and the islands included, can take two days longer than the estimate shown at checkout. Duties and import taxes are the responsibility of the customer and are not collected at checkout.

articles.title: Where is my order
articles.summary: Where your parcel is, why tracking can look stuck, and what happens when it has not turned up.
articles.body:
Where is my order. A tracking number is emailed the moment your parcel leaves our warehouse, so check that email first. Carrier scans can take up to 24 hours to appear, so a tracking page showing no movement on the first day is normal.

If tracking has not updated for 3 business days, the parcel counts as delayed and we will send a replacement at no cost while the carrier investigates.

If tracking shows delivered but nothing arrived, or your parcel has not turned up by the date we gave you, check with neighbours and the building office first, then contact us within 7 days. We will replace or refund the order once a carrier claim is opened.

articles.title: Gear warranty
articles.summary: Lifetime on packs and tents, 2 years on insulation, 12 months on electronics.
articles.body:
Packs and tents carry a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects for the original owner. Zips, buckles and pole sections are repaired free. If a repair is not possible we replace the item with the current equivalent model.

Insulated jackets and sleeping bags are covered for 2 years against down leaking, baffle failure and seams coming apart.

Headlamps, GPS units and other electronics carry a 12 month warranty.

Normal wear, sun damage, damage from poor storage and animal damage are not covered. Send photos and the order number to open a warranty claim.

articles.title: Boot and pack sizing
articles.summary: Size boots half up from street shoes. Packs are sized by torso length.
articles.body:
Hiking boots should be ordered a half size above your street shoe, to leave room for thick socks and for your toes to move on the way downhill. If you are between sizes, size up.

Backpacks are sized by torso length rather than height. Measure from the bump at the base of your neck to the top of your hip bones. Under 16 inches is Small, 16 to 19 inches is Medium, over 19 inches is Large.

Fit exchanges are free both ways within 60 days, including on used gear, as long as it is clean.

articles.title: Price matching
articles.summary: We match a cheaper price at an authorised retailer within 14 days.
articles.body:
Found it cheaper somewhere else. We match the advertised price of any authorised retailer on an identical item that is in stock, including for 14 days after your purchase, where we refund you the difference.

We do not match marketplace sellers, auction listings, membership only pricing, clearance or bundle pricing, or prices that depend on a coupon we cannot verify.

Send a link to the cheaper listing along with your order number and we will check it the same day.

articles.title: Item arrived damaged
articles.summary: Send photos within 7 days. The replacement ships immediately.
articles.body:
If an item arrives damaged, send photos of the item and the shipping box within 7 days of delivery.

We ship the replacement immediately, so you do not have to return the damaged item first. A prepaid return label is included in the replacement box.

If the item is out of stock we refund in full the same day, rather than making you wait.

articles.title: Account and order history
articles.summary: Guest orders link to an account with the same email address.
articles.body:
Orders placed as a guest are linked automatically when you create an account with the same email address.

Password resets are sent to the account email and expire after 60 minutes.

We cannot change the email address on a past order. We can resend the confirmation to a different address once the order number and billing postcode have been verified.

articles.title: Wholesale and guiding service accounts
articles.summary: Trade pricing for guides and outfitters, with a 20 unit minimum.
articles.body:
Certified guides, outdoor schools and rental outfitters qualify for trade pricing at 30 to 40 percent below retail, with a 20 unit opening order.

Applications need a business registration number and proof of certification. Approval takes 2 business days.

Trade accounts are invoiced on 30 day terms and ship free at any order value.

articles.title: When to escalate to a human
articles.summary: Refund disputes over 300 dollars, safety issues, and any legal language.
articles.body:
Escalate to a supervisor straight away for a refund dispute over 300 dollars, any report of injury or gear failure during use, any mention of legal action or a chargeback, wholesale contract terms, and any request to speak to a manager.

Do not offer goodwill credit over 50 dollars without supervisor approval.

For a safety report, collect the batch code from the care label of the item before closing the conversation.

articles.title: Goodwill and compensation limits
articles.summary: Up to 50 dollars at agent discretion. Always record the reason.
articles.body:
Agents may issue up to 50 dollars in store credit without approval, to resolve a service failure such as a missed delivery date, a repeated error, or a long wait.

Anything above 50 dollars, and any cash refund not covered by the returns policy, needs supervisor approval.

Always record the reason on the ticket. Repeat goodwill to the same customer within 90 days needs approval whatever the amount.

articles.title: Backorders and restocks
articles.summary: Backorders are charged at dispatch, and restock alerts go by email.
articles.body:
Backordered items are not charged until they ship. The date shown at checkout comes from the supplier and can move.

You can cancel a backorder at any time before it ships, at no cost.

Restock alerts are sent by email only, once, when the item comes back into stock. They do not reserve any inventory.

articles.title: Caring for technical fabrics
articles.summary: Wash waterproofs with technical detergent, then tumble dry to reactivate the coating.
articles.body:
Wash waterproof shells with a technical detergent, never with regular detergent or fabric softener, because both clog the membrane.

Tumble dry on low for 20 minutes after washing, to reactivate the water repellent coating. If water stops beading after that, reproof it with a wash in treatment.

Down sleeping bags should be stored uncompressed in a large cotton sack. Storing a down bag compressed permanently reduces its loft, and that is not covered by the warranty.

articles.title: Gift cards
articles.summary: A draft. Digital gift cards launch next quarter.
articles.body:
Digital gift cards are delivered by email within 15 minutes of purchase and never expire.

They can be combined with promotions, and cannot be refunded for cash except where the law requires it.

This article is a draft, pending the gift card launch.

conversations.subject: Rain shell delaminated after four trips

messages.author: customer
messages.body: The Ridgeline shell I bought in March has started delaminating along both shoulder seams. I have only had it out four times. Order MO-48221.

messages.author: ai
messages.body: That is covered. Seam separation on a shell is a manufacturing defect, and shells carry a 2 year warranty on that. Could you send photos of both shoulder seams. I will open the claim and get a replacement moving, and there is nothing to send back first.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: Photos attached. I guide professionally so I need this sorted before Saturday, I have clients booked.

messages.author: system
messages.body: Escalated to a human agent. Commercial use, guiding client with a hard deadline.

messages.author: agent
messages.name: Marcus Oyelaran
messages.body: Elena, Marcus here. Those seams are clearly defective, so the claim is approved. I have put a replacement on express so it reaches you Thursday, ahead of Saturday. Nothing to return.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: Hi, I ordered on Monday and the tracking has not moved since Tuesday. MO-49110

messages.author: ai
messages.body: Carrier scans can lag by about 24 hours, so a quiet tracking page early on is normal. Yours is past that though. If it has not moved for 3 business days we treat it as delayed and send a replacement at no cost, and I have flagged it for that.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: It just updated, it is out for delivery. Thanks.

messages.author: ai
messages.body: Good news. I will leave the flag on until it is scanned as delivered, just in case.

conversations.subject: Does the Alpine 45 fit a short torso

messages.author: customer
messages.body: hey, love the alpine 45 but im 5ft 2, will it swallow me

messages.author: ai
messages.body: Height matters less than torso length here. Measure from the bump at the base of your neck to the top of your hip bones. Under 16 inches is our Small, which is almost certainly what you want. Fit exchanges are free both ways within 60 days if it is not right.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: I ordered a 10.5, the box says 10.5 but the boots inside are 9.5. MO-49004

messages.author: ai
messages.body: That is our packing error, so it costs you nothing. I can ship the correct 10.5 today with a prepaid label in the box for the wrong pair, and you do not need to send them back first.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: Perfect, please do that

messages.author: agent
messages.name: Tomas Lindqvist
messages.body: Done, the 10.5 is on its way and arrives Wednesday. The label is in the box. Sorry for the mix up.

conversations.subject: Trade account for an outdoor school

messages.author: customer
messages.body: We run a certified outdoor school with about 200 students a season and currently buy retail. I would like to know what a trade account involves, and whether there is a minimum.

messages.author: ai
messages.body: Outdoor schools qualify. Trade pricing runs 30 to 40 percent below retail with a 20 unit opening order, 30 day invoicing and free shipping at any value. We need your business registration number and proof of certification, and approval takes two business days.

messages.author: system
messages.body: Escalated to a human agent. Wholesale contract terms.

messages.author: agent
messages.name: Priya Raman
messages.body: Maria, I have attached the trade application. Given your volume I can also set up a seasonal pre order, so your spring kit is reserved before the rush. Worth a 20 minute call this week.

conversations.subject: Can I still return something bought 8 weeks ago

messages.author: customer
messages.body: I bought a sleeping bag about 8 weeks ago, never used it, and it is still in the bag. I would like to return it.

messages.author: ai
messages.body: The refund window is 60 days from delivery, so 8 weeks is just inside it if it was delivered promptly. Unused and in original packaging is exactly what qualifies. Send me the order number and I will start it. Return shipping is 7.95 dollars, taken off the refund.

messages.author: customer
messages.body: MO-47882. Thanks, that was easier than expected.

conversations.subject: Bulk order for a rental fleet

messages.author: customer
messages.body: We rent gear at a resort and need 40 sleeping bags before the season. I wanted to ask about trade pricing.

messages.author: agent
messages.name: Priya Raman
messages.body: 40 units clears our minimum comfortably. I have sent trade pricing to your email. At that volume it is 38 percent off retail, invoiced on 30 day terms, with free freight. Let me know the model split and I will confirm stock.

conversations.subject: Is the winter sale on the down parka

messages.author: customer
messages.body: does the sale include the summit down parka or not

messages.author: agent
messages.name: Sofia Institoris
messages.body: It does, 25 percent off through Sunday, and all sizes are still in stock. Worth knowing that we price match authorised retailers for 14 days after purchase too, so you are covered if it drops further.

messages.author: ai
messages.body: Electronics carry a 12 month warranty, so an October purchase is well inside it. A dead charging circuit is a covered defect. I have noted the order, and an agent will confirm the replacement shortly.
